_description: Intercom conversation export (/conversations + Webhooks) → AKSI control ID mapping. Intercom is the dominant chat-first customer-engagement platform; Fin AI handles real-time customer conversations, qualifies leads, and deflects support tickets. Each Fin message is a real-time customer-facing response, fundamentally different from a Zendesk ticket reply: a Fin loop, a poor rating after Fin 'resolved', or a sensitive-tag conversation handled without escalation are governance-relevant signals. Conversation parts (comment / note / fin_answer / fin_handoff / close) drive aggregation. fin_resolved=true with rating<=2 is a false-resolution FAIL; fin_handoff_to_human=true is correct-escalation evidence (PASS); too many fin messages without intervening human is a Fin loop FAIL; sensitive tags (complaint/legal/regulator/gdpr/ccpa) handled exclusively by AI are a PR-04 FAIL; missed SLAs on AI conversations are PR-02 FAILs. High-volume Fin resolution and bad-rating concentration produce synthetic findings.
